note.after_visit_summary: Today we saw your 4-year-old for a checkup. She is growing and developing well. The main concern is constipation: hard stools every few days with pain and holding behavior. We found no blood in stool and her exam was normal except for some stool felt in the lower belly. To help, we are starting MiraLAX: half a capful (8.5 grams) mixed in 4 ounces of water or juice once daily. You can adjust the dose to get a soft poop every day or every other day. Please limit milk to 2 cups a day, offer more fruit and water, and have her sit on the potty for 5 minutes after meals. If there’s no improvement in a month or you see blood, contact us. She also received two vaccines today: DTaP-polio and MMR-chickenpox. She may have a sore leg or mild fever, and a rash or fever 1-2 weeks later is possible from the MMR. If uncomfortable, you may give children’s Tylenol 8 mL. She had her flu shot this year and is up to date. Her next checkup is at age 5. Keep up the great work!
